Here’s a standard `index.html` used in a React project (typically found in the `public` folder of a React app created with Create React App): ```html React App
``` ### What to do: 1. Create a file called `index.html` inside the `public/` folder. 2. Paste the above code into it. 3. Make sure your `src/index.js` or `src/index.tsx` file has something like this to render into `#root`: ```js import React from 'react'; import ReactDOM from 'react-dom'; import App from './App'; ReactDOM.render(, document.getElementById('root')); ``` Let me know if you were using Vite or a custom setup – the HTML structure will be a little different.
